```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
rm(list = ls())
```

# load data
```{r}
expr_file  <- "TCGA-GTEx-TARGET-gene-exp-counts.deseq2-normalized.log2"
pheno_file <- "TcgaTargetGTEX_phenotype.txt"
indir <- "/disk/user/liaoshuilin/project/25.ExoMolePAAD/data/UCSCXenaProject/"
outdir <- "/disk/user/liaoshuilin/project/25.ExoMolePAAD/Result/Exp/"
outdir2 <- "/disk/user/liaoshuilin/project/25.ExoMolePAAD/Result/JiaBo/"
probe_file <- "probeMap_gencode.v23.annotation.gene.probemap"
```

# 1. 根据 phenotype 选择样本
```{r}
pheno <- fread(paste(indir, pheno_file, sep = ""), data.table = FALSE)
sample_col <- grep("sample|Sample|sampleID|SampleID", colnames(pheno), value = TRUE)[1]
pheno$sample <- pheno[[sample_col]]
pheno$all_info <- apply(pheno, 1, function(x) paste(x, collapse = " "))

## TCGA-PAAD 样本
tcga_paad <- pheno %>%
  filter(
    grepl("^TCGA", sample),
    grepl("PAAD|pancreatic|Pancreatic|pancreas|Pancreas", all_info)
  )

## GTEx pancreas normal
gtex_pancreas <- pheno %>%
  filter(
    grepl("^GTEX", sample),
    grepl("pancreas|Pancreas", all_info))

## 根据 TCGA barcode 判断样本类型
## 01 = Primary Tumor
## 11 = Solid Tissue Normal / NAT
tcga_paad$sample_code <- substr(tcga_paad$sample, 14, 15)
tcga_tumor <- tcga_paad %>% filter(sample_code == "01")
tcga_nat <- tcga_paad %>% filter(sample_code == "11")
gtex_normal <- gtex_pancreas

## 合并 metadata
meta <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(sample = tcga_tumor$sample,
             group = "Tumor",
             source = "TCGA",
             subtype = "TCGA_Tumor"),
  data.frame(sample = tcga_nat$sample,
             group = "Normal",
             source = "TCGA",
             subtype = "TCGA_NAT"),
  data.frame(sample = gtex_normal$sample,
             group = "Normal",
             source = "GTEx",
             subtype = "GTEx_Normal"))

meta <- meta[!duplicated(meta$sample), ]
rownames(meta) <- meta$sample

table(meta$subtype)
table(meta$source, meta$group)

meta$group  <- factor(meta$group, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"))
meta$source <- factor(meta$source, levels = c("GTEx", "TCGA"))

write.csv(meta, file.path(outdir2, "1exp/PAAD_TCGA_GTEx_metadata.csv"))
```

# 2. 读取表达矩阵
```{r}
expr <- fread(paste(indir, expr_file, sep = ""), data.table = FALSE)
gene_col <- colnames(expr)[1]
expr <- expr %>% column_to_rownames(gene_col)
expr <- as.matrix(expr)
mode(expr) <- "numeric"

## 只保留目标样本
common_samples <- intersect(meta$sample, colnames(expr))
meta <- meta[common_samples, ]
expr <- expr[, common_samples]

## 去除低表达/低变异基因
keep <- rowSums(expr > 1) >= round(0.2 * ncol(expr))
expr <- expr[keep, ]

# Ensembl -> Gene Symbol
probeMap <- fread(paste(indir, probe_file, sep = ""), data.table = FALSE)
rownames(expr) <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(expr))
probeMap$id <- sub("\\..*$", "", probeMap$id)
probeMap <- probeMap[probeMap$id %in% rownames(expr), ]
expr <- expr[probeMap$id, ]
rownames(expr) <- probeMap$gene
expr <- expr[rownames(expr) != "", ]
expr <- expr[!is.na(rownames(expr)), ]

# 多个 Ensembl 对应同一个 Symbol
expr <- avereps(expr)
a = expr[1:6, 1:6]

write.csv(expr, file.path(outdir2, "1exp/PAAD_TCGA_GTEx_expr.csv"))
```

# 3. 主分析：Tumor vs Normal
```{r}
meta$group <- factor(meta$group, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"))
design_main <- model.matrix(~ group, data = meta)
# design_main <- model.matrix(~ source + group, data = meta)

fit_main <- lmFit(expr, design_main)
fit_main <- eBayes(fit_main)

deg_main <- topTable(
  fit_main,
  coef = "groupTumor",
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH")

deg_main <- deg_main %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene")

deg_main$change <- "NotSig"
deg_main$change[deg_main$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & deg_main$logFC > 1] <- "Up"
deg_main$change[deg_main$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & deg_main$logFC < -1] <- "Down"
table(deg_main$change)

write.csv(
  deg_main,
  file.path(outdir2, "2DEG/01_DEG_main_Tumor_vs_Normal_GTEx_plus_NAT.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)

deg_main_sig <- deg_main %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 1)
table(deg_main_sig$change)

write.csv(
  deg_main_sig,
  file.path(outdir2, "2DEG/01_DEG_main_significant_adjP005_logFC1.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)

```

# 4.2 PCA-v1
```{r}
## =========================
## 1. PCA before adjustment
## =========================
pca_before <- prcomp(t(expr), scale. = TRUE)

var_before <- round(100 * pca_before$sdev^2 / sum(pca_before$sdev^2), 1)

pca_before_df <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(pca_before$x),
  PC1 = pca_before$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_before$x[, 2],
  meta[rownames(pca_before$x), ]
)

## =========================
## 2. Remove source effect for visualization only
## =========================
design_keep_group <- model.matrix(~ group, data = meta)

expr_after <- removeBatchEffect(
  expr,
  batch = meta$source,
  design = design_keep_group
)

pca_after <- prcomp(t(expr_after), scale. = TRUE)

var_after <- round(100 * pca_after$sdev^2 / sum(pca_after$sdev^2), 1)

pca_after_df <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(pca_after$x),
  PC1 = pca_after$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_after$x[, 2],
  meta[rownames(pca_after$x), ]
)

## =========================
## 3. Plot function
## =========================
pca_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

p1 <- ggplot(pca_before_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = source)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  pca_theme +
  labs(
    title = "A. Before adjustment: colored by source",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_before[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_before[2], "%)"),
    color = "Source"
  )

p2 <- ggplot(pca_before_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  pca_theme +
  labs(
    title = "B. Before adjustment: colored by group",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_before[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_before[2], "%)"),
    color = "Group"
  )

p3 <- ggplot(pca_after_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = source)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  pca_theme +
  labs(
    title = "C. After source adjustment: colored by source",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_after[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_after[2], "%)"),
    color = "Source"
  )

p4 <- ggplot(pca_after_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  pca_theme +
  labs(
    title = "D. After source adjustment: colored by group",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_after[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_after[2], "%)"),
    color = "Group"
  )

## =========================
## 4. Patchwork combine
## =========================
p_pca_4panel <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "PCA assessment of TCGA-GTEx source effect",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir2, "figure/PCA_4panel_source_group_pre_post_adjustment.pdf"),
  plot = p_pca_4panel,
  width = 11,
  height = 9
)
```
# 4.2 PCA-v2
```{r}
## PCA before source adjustment
pca1 <- prcomp(t(expr), scale. = TRUE)

pca1_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca1$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca1$x[, 2],
  meta
)

p1 <- ggplot(pca1_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = subtype, shape = source)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA before source adjustment",
    color = "Subtype",
    shape = "Source"
  )

## PCA after source adjustment, only for visualization
design_pca <- model.matrix(~ group, data = meta)

expr_source_removed <- removeBatchEffect(
  expr,
  batch = meta$source,
  design = design_pca
)

pca2 <- prcomp(t(expr_source_removed), scale. = TRUE)

pca2_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca2$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca2$x[, 2],
  meta
)

p2 <- ggplot(pca2_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = subtype, shape = source)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA after source adjustment",
    color = "Subtype",
    shape = "Source"
  )

p_pca_2panel <- p1 + p2
  plot_annotation(
    title = "PCA assessment of TCGA-GTEx source effect",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

p_pca_2panel

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir2, "figure/PCA_2panel_source_group_pre_post_adjustment.pdf"),
  plot = p_pca_2panel,
  width = 9,
  height = 3)
```

# 6. 验证分析：TCGA Tumor vs TCGA NAT
```{r}
meta_tcga <- meta %>%
  filter(source == "TCGA", subtype %in% c("TCGA_Tumor", "TCGA_NAT"))

expr_tcga <- expr[, rownames(meta_tcga)]

meta_tcga$group_tcga <- ifelse(meta_tcga$subtype == "TCGA_Tumor", "Tumor", "NAT")
meta_tcga$group_tcga <- factor(meta_tcga$group_tcga, levels = c("NAT", "Tumor"))

design_tcga <- model.matrix(~ group_tcga, data = meta_tcga)

fit_tcga <- lmFit(expr_tcga, design_tcga)
fit_tcga <- eBayes(fit_tcga)

deg_tcga <- topTable(
  fit_tcga,
  coef = "group_tcgaTumor",
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH"
)

deg_tcga <- deg_tcga %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene")

deg_tcga$change_tcga <- "NotSig"
deg_tcga$change_tcga[deg_tcga$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & deg_tcga$logFC > 1] <- "Up"
deg_tcga$change_tcga[deg_tcga$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & deg_tcga$logFC < -1] <- "Down"

write.csv(
  deg_tcga,
  file.path(outdir2, "2DEG/02_DEG_validation_TCGA_Tumor_vs_NAT.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)

```

# 7. 候选基因在 TCGA Tumor vs NAT 中方向是否一致
```{r}
direction_check <- deg_main_sig %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, logFC_main = logFC, adjP_main = adj.P.Val, change_main = change) %>%
  left_join(
    deg_tcga %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene, logFC_tcga = logFC, adjP_tcga = adj.P.Val, change_tcga),
    by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    same_direction = case_when(
      logFC_main > 0 & logFC_tcga > 0 ~ TRUE,
      logFC_main < 0 & logFC_tcga < 0 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    validated_direction = case_when(
      same_direction == TRUE ~ "Same direction",
      same_direction == FALSE ~ "Opposite direction",
      TRUE ~ "NA"
    )
  )

table(direction_check$validated_direction)

write.csv(
  direction_check,
  file.path(outdir2, "2DEG/03_Main_DEG_direction_validation_in_TCGA_NAT.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)

direction_same <- direction_check %>% filter(same_direction == TRUE)
table(direction_same$change_main)
write.csv(
  direction_same,
  file.path(outdir2, "2DEG/03_Main_DEG_same_direction_in_TCGA_NAT.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)

```

# 8. 针对重点基因画表达箱线图
```{r}
genes_interest <- c("FLOT1", "LCN2", "LRRC42")

plot_df <- expr[intersect(genes_interest, rownames(expr)), , drop = FALSE] %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(intersect(genes_interest, rownames(expr))),
    names_to = "Gene",
    values_to = "Expression"
  )

p_gene <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(subtype, Expression, fill = subtype)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of candidate genes across GTEx Normal, TCGA NAT, and TCGA Tumor",
    x = "",
    y = "log2 normalized expression"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
p_gene

comparisons <- list(
  c("GTEx_Normal", "TCGA_NAT"),
  c("GTEx_Normal", "TCGA_Tumor"),
  c("TCGA_NAT", "TCGA_Tumor")
)

p_gene <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = subtype, y = Expression, fill = subtype)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.18, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6) +

  facet_wrap(~Gene, scales = "free_y") +

  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of candidate genes",
    x = "",
    y = "log2 normalized expression"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_gene

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir2, "figure/important_gene.pdf"),
  plot = p_gene,
  width = 11,
  height = 4)
```
